title_en: Inside Sudair City: the site, the people, the day
title_ar: داخل مدينة سدير: المكان والناس واليوم
objective: A professional sees Sudair City as a place with people in it, and follows the page to see more of it.
hero_en: The picture must say 'this is a place, and people work in it'. Dark emerald left side fading to the real golden-hour drone view of the palm-lined campus; three tall petal-shaped glowing windows in a fan above the campus, each showing a calm scene of people at work from real photos (the lab team standing together, an analyst at the bench, women and men at the packaging line). Mint rim light on the petal edges, soft mist. No people generated, no containers, no readable labels. Keep the top-left corner clear for the logo.
generated_elements: Petal-window frame, dusk sky grade and mint rim light composited over the real campus drone still; petals filled with real photo crops only.
compliance_note: Description of place and people only: no figures, no claims, no products, no readable labels. Staff consent needed for the people in the petals.
sub_en: The site, the people, the day.
caption_ar:
داخل مدينة سدير للصناعات الدوائية، يبدأ اليوم قبل أن تُضاء الواجهة.
مكانٌ يتسع للمختبر وقاعة التعبئة والممرات والنخيل، ويتسع قبل ذلك كله لناسٍ يعرفون بعضهم بالاسم.
جولة قصيرة بين المكان والناس واليوم.
تابعوا الصفحة لنرافقكم أكثر من الداخل.
caption_en:
Inside Sudair City, the day begins before the facade lights come on.
The site holds the lab, the packaging hall, the corridors and the palms. Before all that, it holds people who know each other by name.
A short walk through the place, the people and the day.
Follow the page and see more from the inside.
